title: Sentiment classification - sarcasm (hard)
prompt:
Classify the sentiment of this review. Respond with exactly one of: positive, negative, neutral.
Review: Oh great, ANOTHER package that arrived broken. Fantastic service, really.

metadata.hard_reason: Sarcasm - a naive model latches onto 'great'/'fantastic' and misreads this as positive when the actual content (broken package, capitalized ANOTHER) is clearly negative.
